ai_summary.text:
ニデック（旧日本電産）は精密小型モーターの世界最大手で、ハードディスク用スピンドルモーターと車載用トラクションモーターを主力としている。HDD用モーターで世界シェア80%超という圧倒的な独占的地位を持ち、EVの駆動モーターであるE-Axleへの大型投資を通じて「回るもの、動くもの」全てのモーターを手がける電動化のグローバルリーダーを目指す。

売上2兆6,078億円（前年比+11.1%）と堅調な増収を達成。営業利益2,381億円（営業利益率9.1%）と安定した利益率を実現し、純利益1,644億円。車載モーターの受注拡大とHDDモーターの安定需要が業績を大きく押し上げた。ROE9.6%と高い資本効率を達成。

自己資本比率51.8%で安定した財務基盤を維持しており、財務健全性スコア93点と極めて健全な評価。営業CF2,844億円、FCF1,372億円と圧倒的なキャッシュ創出力。EPS143円に対しPER17.4倍、配当60円で配当性向は約42%。EVの電動化とデータセンターの拡大がモーター需要の構造的成長を力強く支えている。
ai_summary.text_en: Nidec (formerly Nidec Corporation) is the world's largest manufacturer of precision miniature motors, with hard disk drive spindle motors and automotive traction motors as core products. The company holds an overwhelming dominant position with over 80% global market share in HDD motors and aims to become a global leader in electrification, targeting all rotating and moving things through major investments in E-Axle automotive drive motors.  Sales achieved solid growth of 2.6078 trillion yen (+11.1% year-over-year). Operating profit of 238.1 billion yen (operating margin 9.1%) realizes stable profitability, with net profit of 164.4 billion yen. Expanded orders for automotive motors and stable HDD motor demand significantly boosted performance. ROE of 9.6% represents high capital efficiency.  With an equity ratio of 51.8%, the company maintains a stable financial foundation, and financial health score of 93 reflects extremely sound evaluation. Operating cash flow of 284.4 billion yen and FCF of 137.2 billion yen demonstrate overwhelming cash generation capability. At EPS of 143 yen, PER of 17.4x and dividend of 60 yen with payout ratio of approximately 42%. Vehicle electrification and data center expansion structurally support robust motor demand growth.
